C0708.title: Ollama Default Configuration Exposes Data Leakage and Model Theft Risks
C0708.summary: China's National Cybersecurity Notification Center issued a warning about security vulnerabilities in the default configuration of the open-source LLM tool Ollama, including unauthorized access and model theft.
